# Nemo Local
> Local Visibility Score and Utah/Idaho Maps-first guides for home-service SMBs.

## Site
- Home: https://nemo-app-v-1.vercel.app/
- Portal: https://nemo-app-v-1.vercel.app/portal
- Utah guides: https://nemo-app-v-1.vercel.app/ut
- Idaho guides: https://nemo-app-v-1.vercel.app/id
- Sitemap: https://nemo-app-v-1.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

## Product
Nemo Local helps local service businesses understand Google Business Profile gaps with a free Local Visibility Score. Guides focus on Maps completeness first, then GEO citation readiness. No unsupervised profile edits.

## Optional
- Beacon / Echo / Bloom product pages under /products/
